entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return something. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number please?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number is VF8-675-309. I ordered this jersey and it's completely wrong. I'm not paying for this junk.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Pro-Cycle Jersey, delivered five days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference? Are you kidding me? You sent me the wrong size! This thing is so incredibly tight, I can barely get it on. It's useless. I want my money back, now. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration completely, Mark. It's definitely disappointing when an item doesn't fit as expected. I just need to verify our return policy for you.
There's nothing to verify! Just process the refund! If you can't do this, get me your manager. I'm one click away from telling every cycling group I'm in how terrible your sizing and service are.

I can absolutely handle this for you, no need to escalate. I've just confirmed, and since you received the jersey just five days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process a full refund or an exchange for a different size, whichever you prefer.
Oh. Well... ninety days? Okay. So I can get a full refund?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. Would you like me to start that process for you, or would you be interested in an exchange for the correct size?
No, I just want the refund for now. After this, I'm not sure I want to risk getting another wrong size.

I understand. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today, Mark?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
